description: Pins the canonical 0x02 vault.dictionary payload (postcard) and the §10.2.1 union-with-per-word-removal-clocks merge (myne-md/myne#640). input_*_hex and expected_merged_hex are the CANONICAL encoded payloads (NFC + sorted + deduped word sets, sorted clock map). A port that drops a tombstone whose word is in neither input, or that keeps a single-sided entry whose absent-side clock is strictly greater, MUST fail these cases by name.

cases.description: A added 'vodozemac' at clock 100; B is empty. The union keeps the word and carries its clock.
A removed 'myne' at clock 300 (tombstone, word absent); B still holds it at clock 0. The absent side's clock is strictly greater, so the word is DROPPED and the tombstone is retained.
A holds only the 'myne' tombstone at 300; a third device holds 'myne' live at 100. The tombstone wins, the word is DROPPED, and the clock is retained even though neither input lists the word.
A tombstoned 'myne' at 100; B re-added it at 200. The newer add wins and the word is present.
A holds 'tie' at clock 50; B removed it at clock 50. Equal clocks KEEP the entry: an entry that survives one extra round can be deleted again, while one dropped by a collision cannot be recovered.
